staff_accounts.decision.cancel.about.defaultMessage: {outcome, select, mark_sensitive {The sensitive mark is removed. A mark from a moderation action stays.} flag {The decision is cancelled; its report stays to resolve as usual.} drop {What was dropped is processed again while the server still has it; after that, the cancellation is only recorded.} require_approval {The decision is cancelled and recorded; the registration stays where it is.} other {The decision is cancelled and recorded in the audit log.}} This cannot be undone.
staff_accounts.decision.cancel.about.description: Under the question before a decision is cancelled: what cancelling does for its outcome. Read by moderators.

staff_accounts.decision.cancelled_now.description: Said after a decision of a hook was cancelled. Read by moderators.
